```{r load}
library(wet)
library(ggplot2)

vd <- function(f) system.file("vignette-data", f, package = "wet")
v <- readRDS(vd("monthly_values.rds"))
prov <- v$provenance
daily <- readRDS(vd("station_daily.rds"))
lh <- utils::read.csv(vd("life_history_bulk.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = "")

# every value below is the published product's, each checked against what it
# was built from by data-raw/monthly_vignette_data.R: none may differ
stopifnot(identical(prov$published$manifest, wet:::wet_catalog_url), all(prov$published_check$compared > 0),
          all(prov$published_check$differing == 0))

# colours come from the gq registry, so no hex literal appears in this
# vignette; assert the class set, because a malformed CSV row adds a layer silently
reg <- gq::gq_reg_custom(system.file("cartography", "wet_segment.csv", package = "wet"))
reg_st <- gq::gq_reg_custom(system.file("cartography", "wet_station.csv", package = "wet"))
classes <- function(r, layer, expect) {
  x <- gq::gq_tmap_classes(r$layers[[layer]])
  stopifnot(identical(names(x$values), expect))
  list(values = x$values, labels = stats::setNames(x$labels, names(x$values)))
}
pal_src <- classes(reg, "flow_source", c("observed", "pcic_routed", "wet_balance"))
pal_hydro <- classes(reg_st, "hydrograph", c("band", "median", "window"))

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
            theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.minor = element_blank()))
pct <- function(x) paste0(ifelse(round(x) > 0, "+", ""), round(x), "%")
and_text <- function(x) if (length(x) < 2) x else paste(paste(x[-length(x)], collapse = ", "), "and", x[length(x)])
to_title <- function(x) {
  vapply(strsplit(tolower(x), " "), function(w) {
    big <- !w %in% c("at", "the", "near", "of")
    w[big] <- paste0(toupper(substring(w[big], 1, 1)), substring(w[big], 2))
    paste(w, collapse = " ")
  }, "")
}
days <- c(365.25, wet_month_days())
base <- 1981:2010
base_text <- paste0(min(base), "–", max(base))
period_of <- function(src) unique(v$segments$period[v$segments$source == src])
# the product spells a period with a hyphen; the prose with an en dash
stopifnot(identical(period_of("wet_balance"), paste0(min(base), "-", max(base))),
          length(period_of("pcic_routed")) == 1)
routed_text <- sub("-", "–", period_of("pcic_routed"))
```

The published discharge table (`vignette("segment-discharge")`) gives every
FWA segment thirteen values per source: the mean annual flow (month 0) and the
mean flow of each calendar month (months 1–12). This article is about the
twelve months. It shows how to read them for one stream, sets them against
observed flow and Chinook life-stage windows on the Bulkley River, and scores
both sources month by month at the gauges the water balance is calibrated on.
The scores are where the monthly values are right and where they are not, and
the article ends with the list of what to fix.

## What a month holds

```{r months}
sg <- v$segments
stations <- c("08EE013", "08EE003", "08EE004")
names_st <- c(stats::setNames(attr(daily, "provenance")$stations$station_name,
                              attr(daily, "provenance")$stations$station_number),
              stats::setNames(unique(v$gauges[c("station_number", "station_name")])$station_name,
                              unique(v$gauges[c("station_number", "station_name")])$station_number))
st_label <- stats::setNames(sprintf("%s (%s)", to_title(names_st[stations]), stations), stations)

# routed month 0 is the plain mean of its twelve months; weighted by days it
# differs by this much on the Bulkley segments
r <- sg[sg$source == "pcic_routed", ]
wtd <- vapply(stations, function(s) {
  q <- r$q_m3s[r$station_number == s & r$month > 0][order(r$month[r$station_number == s & r$month > 0])]
  sum(q * days[-1]) / sum(days[-1])
}, 0)
plain <- r$q_m3s[r$month == 0][match(stations, r$station_number[r$month == 0])]
wtd_diff <- max(abs(100 * (plain / wtd - 1)))
```

Each source fills the twelve months its own way:

- **Routed PCIC** (`pcic_routed`) is the mean of each month's daily flow over
  `r routed_text` from PCIC's Raven routing of VIC-GL runoff, placed on FWA
  segments by NewGraphEnvironment/fwapg#6. Its month 0 is the plain mean of the
  twelve months, not weighted by their days. On the three segments below that
  moves it by at most `r sprintf("%.1f%%", wtd_diff)`.
- **The water balance** (`wet_balance`) is the annual flow over `r base_text`
  split into months by a model of each month's share of the year, fitted to the
  gauges (`wet_share_fit()`). Its months are volume shares of its month 0, so
  they add up to it exactly.

The two sources cover different periods. Neither is the gauge record. Each
comparison below says which period it uses.

## Reading a segment's twelve months

The parts are public and the bucket allows no listing, so the manifest names
them. One stream is one `linear_feature_id`. Filtering on its watershed group
as well lets duckdb skip every part that cannot hold it, which keeps the read to
seconds.

```{r read, echo = TRUE, eval = FALSE}
library(wet)
parts <- wet_catalog()
parts <- parts[parts$dataset == "discharge/fwa/v1/segment_monthly" & parts$scenario == "historical", ]

con <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb())
DBI::dbExecute(con, "LOAD httpfs")
# Buck Creek at its mouth, where gauge 08EE013 sits
q <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, sprintf("
  SELECT source, month, q_m3s, period, pick
  FROM read_parquet([%s], hive_partitioning = true)
  WHERE watershed_group_code = 'BULK' AND linear_feature_id = 17094080
  ORDER BY source, month", paste0("'", parts$href, "'", collapse = ", ")))
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)

# twelve months a column per source
reshape(q[q$month > 0, c("source", "month", "q_m3s")], idvar = "month",
        timevar = "source", direction = "wide")
```

`data-raw/monthly_vignette_data.R` runs this query and refuses to bundle the
values below unless it returns them. Once `wet_segment_monthly()` lands (#59),
it does the same read in one call.

## The Bulkley at three gauges

```{r bulkley}
stopifnot(identical(unique(sg$linear_feature_id[sg$station_number == "08EE013"]), 17094080L))
ch <- lh[lh$species_code == "CH" & lh$life_stage %in% c("migration", "spawning", "fry_migration"), ]
stopifnot(nrow(ch) == 3, all(ch$end > ch$start))  # none crosses the new year
stage <- sub("_", " ", ch$life_stage)
windows <- data.frame(window = paste0(toupper(substring(stage, 1, 1)), substring(stage, 2)),
                      start = ch$start, end = ch$end)
md_text <- function(md) {
  d <- as.Date(paste0("2001-", md))
  paste(format(d, "%b"), as.integer(format(d, "%d")))
}

# observed monthly means, 1981-2010: the calibration record (complete years)
# where the gauge is a calibration gauge, otherwise the daily record's
# month-years with at least 20 days of flow, in months that have 10 of them
g <- v$gauges
obs_cal <- g[g$station_number %in% stations & g$month > 0, ]
obs_cal$q_m3s <- obs_cal$obs_mm * obs_cal$area_km2 * 1e6 / (days[obs_cal$month + 1] * 86400 * 1000)
obs_cal$n_years <- obs_cal$n_years
min_days <- 20
min_years <- 10
dh <- daily[daily$source == "hydat", ]
dh$year <- as.integer(format(dh$date, "%Y"))
dh$month <- as.integer(format(dh$date, "%m"))
dh <- dh[dh$year %in% base, ]
my <- stats::aggregate(q_m3s ~ station_number + year + month, dh, function(q) c(mean = mean(q), n = length(q)))
my <- data.frame(my[c("station_number", "year", "month")], q = my$q_m3s[, "mean"], n = my$q_m3s[, "n"])
my <- my[my$n >= min_days, ]
obs_daily <- stats::aggregate(q ~ station_number + month, my, function(q) c(mean = mean(q), n = length(q)))
obs_daily <- data.frame(obs_daily[c("station_number", "month")], q_m3s = obs_daily$q[, "mean"],
                        n_years = obs_daily$q[, "n"])
obs_daily <- obs_daily[obs_daily$n_years >= min_years, ]
not_cal <- setdiff(stations, unique(g$station_number))
stopifnot(identical(not_cal, "08EE003"))
obs <- rbind(obs_cal[c("station_number", "month", "q_m3s", "n_years")],
             obs_daily[obs_daily$station_number %in% not_cal, ])
obs$source <- "observed"
# 08EE003 is seasonal: the months it has, and the years they come from
m003 <- sort(obs$month[obs$station_number == "08EE003"])
stopifnot(identical(m003, min(m003):max(m003)))
m003_text <- paste0(month.name[min(m003)], "–", month.name[max(m003)])
n003 <- length(unique(my$year[my$station_number == "08EE003" & my$month %in% m003]))

mid <- function(m) as.Date(sprintf("2001-%02d-15", m))
hyd <- rbind(sg[sg$month > 0, c("station_number", "month", "q_m3s", "source")],
             obs[c("station_number", "month", "q_m3s", "source")])
hyd$date <- mid(hyd$month)
hyd$source <- factor(hyd$source, names(pal_src$values))
hyd$station_number <- factor(hyd$station_number, stations, st_label[stations])

# the windows as strips under each panel, one row each
top <- stats::aggregate(q_m3s ~ station_number, hyd, max)
strip <- merge(top, data.frame(window = windows$window, row = seq_len(nrow(windows)),
                               start = as.Date(paste0("2001-", windows$start)),
                               end = as.Date(paste0("2001-", windows$end))), by = NULL)
strip$y <- -strip$q_m3s * (0.04 + 0.07 * (strip$row - 1)) - strip$q_m3s * 0.03
strip$h <- strip$q_m3s * 0.045
strip$label_x <- strip$end + 4

# numbers the prose names: the freshet at Buck Creek
bk <- function(src, m) hyd$q_m3s[hyd$station_number == st_label[["08EE013"]] & hyd$source == src & hyd$month == m]
peak_month <- function(src) {
  x <- hyd[hyd$station_number == st_label[["08EE013"]] & hyd$source == src, ]
  x$month[which.max(x$q_m3s)]
}
stopifnot(peak_month("observed") == 5, peak_month("pcic_routed") == 5)
bal_peak <- month.name[peak_month("wet_balance")]

cap_hyd <- paste0(
  "Mean monthly flow on the segments three Bulkley gauges sit on, from each source, beside the gauge's ",
  "observed monthly means over ", base_text, ". Routed PCIC is over ", routed_text, ". At ",
  st_label[["08EE003"]], ", a seasonal gauge, only the months with ", min_years, " or more years of ",
  min_days, " days' flow are drawn (", m003_text, "). The strips under each panel are the Chinook windows."
)
```

```{r hydrographs, fig.height = 7.2, fig.cap = cap_hyd}
ggplot(hyd) +
  geom_rect(data = strip, aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = y - h / 2, ymax = y + h / 2),
            fill = pal_hydro$values[["window"]]) +
  geom_text(data = strip, aes(x = label_x, y = y, label = window), hjust = 0, size = 2.6, colour = "grey30") +
  geom_line(aes(date, q_m3s, colour = source), linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(aes(date, q_m3s, colour = source), size = 1.2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pal_src$values, labels = pal_src$labels, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b",
               limits = as.Date(c("2001-01-01", "2001-12-31")), expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
  facet_wrap(~station_number, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean flow (m³/s)")
```

```{r bulkley-numbers}
freshet <- function(s, src) {
  x <- hyd[hyd$station_number == st_label[[s]] & hyd$source == src & hyd$month %in% 5:6, ]
  sum(x$q_m3s * days[x$month + 1]) / sum(days[x$month + 1])
}
fr <- vapply(c("observed", "pcic_routed", "wet_balance"), function(src) freshet("08EE013", src), 0)
fr_q <- vapply(c("observed", "pcic_routed", "wet_balance"), function(src) freshet("08EE004", src), 0)
hq <- function(s, src, mo) {
  x <- hyd[hyd$station_number == st_label[[s]] & hyd$source == src & hyd$month %in% mo, ]
  x$q_m3s[order(x$month)]
}
# the prose: at Buck Creek the balance is above the gauge from July to March;
# at Quick it is above it January to April, and routed above it in July and August
stopifnot(all(hq("08EE013", "wet_balance", c(7:12, 1:3)) > hq("08EE013", "observed", c(7:12, 1:3))),
          all(hq("08EE004", "wet_balance", 1:4) > hq("08EE004", "observed", 1:4)),
          all(hq("08EE004", "pcic_routed", 7:8) > hq("08EE004", "observed", 7:8)),
          fr[["pcic_routed"]] > fr[["observed"]], fr[["wet_balance"]] < fr[["observed"]],
          max(hq("08EE013", "wet_balance", 1:12)) < max(hq("08EE013", "observed", 1:12)) / 2)
bk_peak <- c(obs = max(hq("08EE013", "observed", 1:12)), wb = max(hq("08EE013", "wet_balance", 1:12)))
```

At Buck Creek (08EE013), a snowmelt stream of `r round(unique(g$area_km2[g$station_number == "08EE013"]))`
km², the gauge peaks in May and so does routed PCIC, which overshoots it. The
water balance has hardly a freshet: its May–June flow is
`r round(fr[["wet_balance"]], 1)` m³/s against `r round(fr[["observed"]], 1)`
observed and `r round(fr[["pcic_routed"]], 1)` routed, and its highest month,
`r bal_peak`, is `r round(bk_peak[["wb"]], 1)` m³/s against the gauge's May
`r round(bk_peak[["obs"]], 1)`. It carries more water than the gauge from July through March. On the Bulkley at Quick (08EE004),
a basin of `r format(round(unique(g$area_km2[g$station_number == "08EE004"])), big.mark = ",")` km²,
both sources come close to the gauge in May–June
(`r round(fr_q[["observed"]])` m³/s observed, `r round(fr_q[["pcic_routed"]])` routed,
`r round(fr_q[["wet_balance"]])` balance). The balance is still high from January
to April, and routed PCIC is high in July and August.

Both gauges are among those the balance is calibrated on, so on their segments
its published values are in-sample. The scores further down use the balance
held out instead. 08EE003 is not a calibration gauge: it is seasonal and has
no complete years, so on its segment the balance is a genuine estimate for an
ungauged site, and the gauge can check it only in open water.

## Flow in the Chinook windows

```{r windows}
# the gauge's daily record, as the station-flow article reads it: the mean
# over each window, in each 1981-2010 year with enough of the window's days
ws <- wet_window_stats(dh[dh$station_number %in% c("08EE013", "08EE003"), c("station_number", "date", "q_m3s")],
                       windows, stats = "mean")
# a window's mean from monthly means: each day takes its month's mean
from_months <- function(q12, start, end) {
  d <- seq(as.Date(paste0("2001-", start)), as.Date(paste0("2001-", end)), by = "day")
  mean(q12[as.integer(format(d, "%m"))])
}
q12 <- function(s, src) {
  x <- sg[sg$station_number == s & sg$source == src & sg$month > 0, ]
  x$q_m3s[order(x$month)]
}
win <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("08EE013", "08EE003"), function(s) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(windows)), function(k) {
    w <- windows[k, ]
    yrs <- ws$year[ws$station_number == s & ws$period == w$window]
    # the observed months over the same years as the daily means
    mo <- my[my$station_number == s & my$year %in% yrs, ]
    om <- stats::aggregate(q ~ month, mo, mean)
    obs12 <- rep(NA_real_, 12)
    obs12[om$month] <- om$q
    data.frame(station_number = s, window = w$window, span = paste(md_text(w$start), "–", md_text(w$end)),
               years = length(yrs),
               daily = mean(ws$value[ws$station_number == s & ws$period == w$window]),
               obs_months = from_months(obs12, w$start, w$end),
               routed = from_months(q12(s, "pcic_routed"), w$start, w$end),
               balance = from_months(q12(s, "wet_balance"), w$start, w$end))
  }))
}))
stopifnot(!anyNA(win), all(win$years >= min_years))
approx_err <- 100 * (win$obs_months / win$daily - 1)
err_of <- function(col) 100 * (win[[col]] / win$daily - 1)
# the approximation per window, at its worse gauge
approx_w <- tapply(abs(approx_err), win$window, max)[windows$window]
good_w <- names(approx_w)[approx_w < 5]
poor_w <- names(approx_w)[approx_w >= 5]
# the prose: where it is poor, both sources still miss by more
stopifnot(length(good_w) > 0, length(poor_w) > 0,
          all(abs(err_of("routed")[win$window %in% poor_w]) > abs(approx_err[win$window %in% poor_w])),
          all(abs(err_of("balance")[win$window %in% poor_w]) > abs(approx_err[win$window %in% poor_w])))
# and the reason it gives: the second half of July runs below July's mean
late_july <- vapply(c("08EE013", "08EE003"), function(st) {
  x <- dh[dh$station_number == st & dh$month == 7, ]
  mean(x$q_m3s[as.integer(format(x$date, "%d")) >= 15]) / mean(x$q_m3s)
}, 0)
stopifnot(identical(poor_w, "Fry migration"), all(late_july < 0.9))
```

The windows start and end mid-month, and the product holds monthly means. A
window's flow from the product is therefore a day-weighted mean: each day of
the window takes its month's mean. The first two numeric columns of the table
below separate that approximation from model error. The first is the gauge's
own daily record, averaged over the window in each year, and the second is the
same years' observed monthly means put through the day weighting. In
`r tolower(and_text(good_w))` they agree within
`r sprintf("%.0f%%", max(approx_w[good_w]))`. In `r tolower(and_text(poor_w))`
they differ by up to `r sprintf("%.0f%%", max(approx_w[poor_w]))`, because that
window takes half of July, when the flow is falling fast, at July's mean. Even
there the approximation is smaller than either source's error in the two
columns after them, which is as large as
`r pct(err_of("routed")[which.max(abs(err_of("routed")))])` for routed PCIC and
`r pct(err_of("balance")[which.max(abs(err_of("balance")))])` for the balance.

```{r window-table}
tab <- data.frame(
  Gauge = st_label[win$station_number], Window = paste0(win$window, " (", win$span, ")"),
  Years = win$years,
  `Daily record` = sprintf("%.1f", win$daily),
  `Monthly, day-weighted` = sprintf("%.1f", win$obs_months),
  `Routed PCIC` = sprintf("%.1f (%s)", win$routed, pct(err_of("routed"))),
  `Water balance` = sprintf("%.1f (%s)", win$balance, pct(err_of("balance"))),
  check.names = FALSE
)
tab$Gauge[duplicated(tab$Gauge)] <- ""
knitr::kable(tab, row.names = FALSE, align = "llrrrrr",
             caption = paste0("Mean flow (m³/s) in each Chinook window. Daily record: the gauge's mean over the window, ",
                              "averaged over the years in ", base_text, " with enough of its days. ",
                              "Monthly, day-weighted: the same years' observed monthly means, each day taking its ",
                              "month's mean. The two sources are day-weighted the same way, from their own periods, ",
                              "with their difference from the daily record in brackets."))
```

## Monthly error at the gauges

```{r scores}
a <- g[g$month == 0, ]
# a gauge whose segment carries under this share of its observed flow is a
# side channel, a reservoir or a misplaced outlet, not model error
# (scripts/pcic_routed_lib.R, routed_far_low)
far_low <- 0.2
far <- a$station_number[!is.na(a$routed_mm) & a$routed_mm < far_low * a$obs_mm]
n_routed <- sum(!is.na(a$routed_mm))
m <- g[g$month > 0, ]
min_mm <- 1
lr <- function(mod, ok) ifelse(ok, log(mod / m$obs_mm), NA_real_)
m$lr_wb <- lr(m$wb_mm, m$obs_mm >= min_mm & m$wb_mm > 0)
m$lr_r <- lr(m$routed_mm, m$obs_mm >= min_mm & m$routed_mm > 0 & !m$station_number %in% far)
n_low_obs <- sum(m$obs_mm < min_mm)
n_zero_wb <- sum(m$obs_mm >= min_mm & m$wb_mm <= 0)
both <- m[!is.na(m$lr_wb) & !is.na(m$lr_r), ]
n_both_gauges <- length(unique(both$station_number))
band <- 0.2
summ <- function(x, src) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(split(x, both$month), function(r) {
    data.frame(source = src, median = 100 * (exp(stats::median(r)) - 1),
               q25 = 100 * (exp(stats::quantile(r, 0.25, names = FALSE)) - 1),
               q75 = 100 * (exp(stats::quantile(r, 0.75, names = FALSE)) - 1),
               within = 100 * mean(abs(exp(r) - 1) <= band))
  }))
}
sm <- rbind(cbind(month = 1:12, summ(both$lr_wb, "wet_balance")), cbind(month = 1:12, summ(both$lr_r, "pcic_routed")))
smv <- function(src, mo, col) sm[[col]][sm$source == src & sm$month %in% mo]
sm$date <- mid(sm$month)
sm$source <- factor(sm$source, names(pal_src$values))

# per-gauge skill on the monthly climatology (wet_flow_validate(), as the
# water-balance report scores it)
sk_wb <- wet_flow_validate(data.frame(station_number = g$station_number, month = g$month,
                                      obs = g$obs_mm, mod = g$wb_mm))
r_ok <- !is.na(g$routed_mm) & !g$station_number %in% far
sk_r <- wet_flow_validate(data.frame(station_number = g$station_number[r_ok], month = g$month[r_ok],
                                     obs = g$obs_mm[r_ok], mod = g$routed_mm[r_ok]))
nse <- function(sk, col) stats::median(sk$stations[[col]][sk$stations$station_number %in% both$station_number],
                                       na.rm = TRUE)
cap_err <- paste0(
  "Error in mean monthly flow at ", n_both_gauges, " calibration gauges, by month: the median (line) and the ",
  "middle half of gauges (band), as a percentage of the gauge's ", base_text, " mean. ",
  "The water balance is held out (blocked cross-validation); routed PCIC is over ", routed_text, ". ",
  "Dashed lines mark ±", round(100 * band), "%."
)
```

Monthly flow is scored at the `r length(unique(g$station_number))` gauges the
water balance is calibrated on, against each gauge's monthly means over its
complete years in `r base_text`. The balance is scored **held out**: each gauge's
months come from a fit that never saw it or its neighbours (blocked
cross-validation, as `research/water_balance_method.md` describes), recomputed
by the data script and checked against the fit's stored held-out annual values.
Routed PCIC is scored on the segment each gauge snapped to, at the
`r n_routed` gauges where it has flow, less `r length(far)` whose segment carries
under `r round(100 * far_low)`% of the observed annual flow (side channels,
reservoirs and misplaced outlets, as in the annual routed comparison). A
gauge-month is left out when its observed mean is under `r min_mm` mm
(`r n_low_obs` months) or the
balance's held-out share for it is zero (`r n_zero_wb` months). The figure and
table use the `r format(nrow(both), big.mark = ",")` gauge-months both sources
have, at `r n_both_gauges` gauges.

```{r error-month, fig.height = 4.2, fig.cap = cap_err}
ggplot(sm, aes(date)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-1, 1) * 100 * band, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q25, ymax = q75, fill = source), alpha = 0.18) +
  geom_line(aes(y = median, colour = source), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(y = median, colour = source), size = 1.3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pal_src$values[-1], labels = pal_src$labels[-1], name = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal_src$values[-1], labels = pal_src$labels[-1], name = NULL) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b",
               limits = as.Date(c("2001-01-01", "2001-12-31")), expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Error in mean monthly flow")
```

```{r error-table}
et <- data.frame(Month = month.abb,
                 `Balance median` = pct(smv("wet_balance", 1:12, "median")),
                 `Balance within ±20%` = sprintf("%.0f%%", smv("wet_balance", 1:12, "within")),
                 `Routed median` = pct(smv("pcic_routed", 1:12, "median")),
                 `Routed within ±20%` = sprintf("%.0f%%", smv("pcic_routed", 1:12, "within")),
                 check.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(et, align = "lrrrr",
             caption = paste0("Median error in mean monthly flow, and the share of gauges within ±",

```

```{r score-text}
wb_hi <- which.max(smv("wet_balance", 1:12, "median"))
r_spring <- 3:4
r_summer <- 7:8
wb_high <- which(smv("wet_balance", 1:12, "median") > 0)
r_closer <- which(smv("pcic_routed", 1:12, "within") > smv("wet_balance", 1:12, "within"))
# the prose: the balance is high December to May, within the band at fewer
# than half the gauges in every month; routed is low in spring and high in summer
stopifnot(all(c(12, 1:5) %in% wb_high), max(smv("wet_balance", 1:12, "within")) < 50,
          all(smv("pcic_routed", r_spring, "median") < -10), all(smv("pcic_routed", r_summer, "median") > 10),
          all(5:9 %in% r_closer))
# routed over its own period at the long-record gauges: observed 1951-2012
# complete years against routed 1951-2012 on the same months
p <- v$period
stopifnot(identical(range(base), c(1981L, 2010L)), identical(routed_text, "1951–2012"))
lp <- merge(p[p$month > 0, ], g[g$month > 0, c("station_number", "month", "routed_mm", "area_km2")],
            by = c("station_number", "month"))
lp$routed_q <- lp$routed_mm * lp$area_km2 * 1e6 / (days[lp$month + 1] * 86400 * 1000)
lp <- lp[!is.na(lp$routed_q) & lp$routed_q > 0 & !lp$station_number %in% far, ]
n_long <- length(unique(lp$station_number))
long_med <- function(num, den, mo) {
  x <- lp[lp$month %in% mo, ]
  100 * (exp(stats::median(log(x[[num]] / x[[den]]))) - 1)
}
per_med <- function(mo) {
  x <- p[p$month %in% mo & p$station_number %in% lp$station_number, ]
  100 * (exp(stats::median(log(x$q_m3s_5112 / x$q_m3s_8110))) - 1)
}
```

The two sources fail in different seasons.

- **The water balance** reads high from December to May, by a median of
  up to `r pct(smv("wet_balance", wb_hi, "median"))` (`r month.name[wb_hi]`),
  and its spread is wide in every month: fewer than half of the gauges fall within
  ±`r round(100 * band)`% in any month. Its months are an annual flow times a
  share of the year modelled from monthly precipitation, temperature and
  evapotranspiration, with no snow in it. That flattens the freshet at
  snowmelt gauges such as Buck Creek, moving its water into the months either
  side. Held out, its median Nash–Sutcliffe efficiency on the monthly
  climatology is `r sprintf("%.2f", nse(sk_wb, "nse_month"))` at these gauges.
  This error is ours. Snow predictors for the shares are #16.
- **Routed PCIC** has its freshet in the right months, and more of its gauges
  are within ±`r round(100 * band)`% than the balance's in
  `r length(r_closer)` of the twelve months, May to September among them. It reads low in March and April (median
  `r pct(mean(smv("pcic_routed", r_spring, "median")))`) and high in July and
  August (`r pct(mean(smv("pcic_routed", r_summer, "median")))`): as if its melt
  starts late and runs on. Its median monthly efficiency is
  `r sprintf("%.2f", nse(sk_r, "nse_month"))`.

Routed PCIC's period is `r routed_text` and the gauges' is `r base_text`, so
part of its error could be the period. At the `r n_long` calibration gauges with
40 or more complete years in `r routed_text` and routed flow on their segment, observed flow over the longer period
differs from `r base_text` by a median of `r pct(per_med(r_spring))` in March–April
and `r pct(per_med(r_summer))` in July–August. Scored against the gauges' own
`r routed_text` means, routed PCIC is still `r pct(long_med("routed_q", "q_m3s_5112", r_spring))`
in March–April and `r pct(long_med("routed_q", "q_m3s_5112", r_summer))` in July–August.
Against `r base_text` at the same gauges it is `r pct(long_med("routed_q", "q_m3s_8110", r_spring))`
and `r pct(long_med("routed_q", "q_m3s_8110", r_summer))`. The period explains part
of the summer excess and little of the spring shortfall. What is left is a shape error: an
outlet placed on the wrong segment scales every month alike and cannot move
water between seasons, so the shape comes from the routed model, not from the
placement. That attributes it to PCIC's model, which wet does not run; it is
recorded here and in #6. Routed flow over `r base_text` (NewGraphEnvironment/fwapg#25)
would remove the period question.

```{r groups}
grp <- unique(g[c("station_number", "area_class", "lake")])
grp$lake <- ifelse(grp$lake %in% TRUE, "lake outlet", "not a lake outlet")
grp <- grp[grp$station_number %in% both$station_number, ]
gw <- wet_flow_validate(data.frame(station_number = g$station_number, month = g$month, obs = g$obs_mm,
                                   mod = g$wb_mm)[g$station_number %in% both$station_number, ], grp)$summary
gr <- wet_flow_validate(data.frame(station_number = g$station_number, month = g$month, obs = g$obs_mm,
                                   mod = g$routed_mm)[g$station_number %in% both$station_number, ], grp)$summary
key <- function(s) paste(s$group, s$value)
gt <- data.frame(Group = ifelse(gw$group == "all", "All gauges",
                                ifelse(gw$group == "lake", paste0(toupper(substring(gw$value, 1, 1)),
                                                                  substring(gw$value, 2)),
                                       sub("km2", "km²", gw$value))),
                 Gauges = gw$n,
                 Balance = sprintf("%.2f", gw$nse_month_median),
                 Routed = sprintf("%.2f", gr$nse_month_median[match(key(gw), key(gr))]))
gt <- gt[match(c("all all", paste("area_class", c("<100 km2", "100-1000", "1000-10000", ">10000")),
                 "lake lake outlet", "lake not a lake outlet"), key(gw)), ]
stopifnot(!anyNA(gt$Group))
nse_g <- function(s, g, v) s$nse_month_median[s$group == g & s$value == v]
# the prose: routed is weaker than the balance only on the smallest basins,
# and the balance is weakest at lake outlets
small <- "<100 km2"
classes_a <- c("<100 km2", "100-1000", "1000-10000", ">10000")
stopifnot(nse_g(gr, "area_class", small) < nse_g(gw, "area_class", small),
          all(vapply(setdiff(classes_a, small), function(k) nse_g(gr, "area_class", k) > nse_g(gw, "area_class", k), NA)),
          nse_g(gw, "lake", "lake outlet") < min(gw$nse_month_median[gw$group == "area_class"]))
```

A second place was not needed to find these patterns, because the province-wide
scores already span regimes. The table below splits them by basin size and by
lake outlets, which a regime contrast would have sampled one at a time. Routed
PCIC is the stronger source on every basin size but the smallest (under
100 km²), where it falls below the balance. The balance is weakest at lake
outlets, whose flow a lake holds back and releases later in the year; its shares
know nothing of the lake, and routing does.

```{r group-table}
knitr::kable(gt, row.names = FALSE, align = "lrrr",
             caption = paste("Median Nash–Sutcliffe efficiency of the monthly climatology per gauge,",
                             "by basin size and lake outlets, on the gauges of the figure above."))
```

```{r period-check}
# the prose: the period moves each season by under 10%; over its own period
# routed stays more than 10% low in spring, and stays high in summer by less
# than against 1981-2010
stopifnot(abs(per_med(r_spring)) < 10, abs(per_med(r_summer)) < 10,
          long_med("routed_q", "q_m3s_5112", r_spring) < -10,
          long_med("routed_q", "q_m3s_5112", r_summer) > 5,
          long_med("routed_q", "q_m3s_5112", r_summer) < long_med("routed_q", "q_m3s_8110", r_summer))
```

## What's next

What this exploration found that would make the monthly values more useful,
each with its issue:

- **Snow in the balance's monthly shares** (#16). The balance flattens the
  freshet and reads high in winter. Snow predictors are the obvious first
  change, scored on the same held-out gauge-months as here.
- **Routed flow over `r base_text`** (NewGraphEnvironment/fwapg#25), so both
  sources and the gauges share one period.
- **Routed PCIC's seasonal shape** (#67): low in early spring, high in late
  summer, beyond what the period explains. Attributed to PCIC's model. The
  issue records the evidence and a draft report to PCIC.
- **Store the held-out monthly balance with the fit** (#68). Today only its annual
  values are stored, so this article's data script recomputes the months.
- **Per-segment monthly reads in one call** (#59), which replaces the duckdb
  recipe above.
- **Monthly scoring by region and season** (#6), which takes over the scoring
  this article starts.

## Limits

- On a calibration gauge's own segment the published balance is in-sample. The
  scores above use the held-out balance instead.
- 08EE003 is seasonal: its monthly means cover `r m003_text`, from
  `r n003` of the years `r base_text`, and its windows rest on those years.
- A window's flow from monthly means is an approximation (the window table measures it).
- Routed PCIC's month 0 is a plain mean of its months, so its months converted
  to millimetres do not add up to its annual runoff exactly.

## Validation

```{r provenance}
pc <- prov$published_check
```

`data-raw/monthly_vignette_data.R` built the data at wet `r prov$wet_commit`
on `r format(prov$built)`, from the published build at wet
`r prov$published$wet_commit` (`r prov$published$manifest`) and the water
balance fit on HYDAT `r substr(prov$hydat_release, 1, 10)` (AET `r prov$aet`). It checked every
bundled published value against what it was built from, and refused to write
unless none differed:

```{r provenance-table}
knitr::kable(data.frame(Check = pc$check, Compared = format(pc$compared, big.mark = ","),
                        Differing = pc$differing),
             row.names = FALSE, align = "lrr",
             caption = "Published values against their sources.")
```

On the machine that built it, the fit's output held month 0 only, so the
balance's months 1–12 were recomputed for the watersheds it held. The rest
rest on the publish report's value-by-value check of every month
(`data/checks/discharge_publish_20260717.txt`), which the script requires to have
passed for the live build. The held-out monthly balance was recomputed with
the fit's own procedure, and its annual values equal the stored ones exactly.
Routed flow is fwapg `r prov$routed_commit`'s table (`r prov$routed_fingerprint`).
